framework_metadata.description: 2x B200 (183 GB), fully resident -- no layerwise offload needed at this memory class.
framework_metadata.notes: Validated 2026-08-07 on 2 independent fresh 2xB200 devboxes (h3-b200-2gpu-v2 and its predecessor), same request as the rtx5090-2gpu profile. Two back-to-back runs agreed to 2 decimal places: client wall 80.64s/80.63s, server-reported inference_time_s 75.42/75.42, peak_memory_mb 108328/108358 (well under the 183 GB budget -- room to spare, unlike the 32 GB RTX5090 profile which needs the layerwise-offload knobs). ~7.6x faster wall-clock than the rtx5090-2gpu profile on the identical request; expected given B200's raw compute plus the total absence of the 5090 recipe's CPU<->GPU layerwise-transfer tax. See the vllm-omni entry's b200-2gpu profile for the cross-framework comparison on the same hardware.

framework_metadata.notes: Replaces blackwell-tp2-fa2: FlashAttention 2 on Blackwell is the slow exact kernel, and that profile was never validated (its notes said so); it published 141.04 s on minimax_h3_t2va_5s (4xGB300, 2026-10-10) against sglang's 57.46 s. LightX2V's MiniMax-H3 attention is single-segment (transformer_infer.py builds cu_seqlens = (0, seq_len)), so torch_sdpa -- cuDNN SDPA on sm_100/sm_103 -- computes the same attention. flash_attn4 also takes single-segment input, but the installer removes flash_attn.cute (no cutlass-dsl satisfies it). Probed 2026-10-12 on a 2xGB300 gb300-tml pod (LightX2V b6d38283, torch 2.14.1), minimax_h3_t2va_5s: torch_sdpa TP2 68.90 s, torch_sdpa Ulysses2 67.32 s, sglang main on the same pod 62.52 s. VALIDATION on a whole-node 4xGB300 pending.

framework_metadata.description: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen, NVIDIA's official minimax-h3-bf16-8gpu.yaml at BF16, 2 GPU(s).
framework_metadata.notes: H3 multi-GPU is pure Ulysses (cfg_size 1: guidance-distilled); CUDA graphs, caches and a non-empty negative prompt are rejected; num_frames must be 17n+5 (124); MiniMaxH3Scheduler counts sigma grid points, so 50 = 49 evaluations as in sglang; flow shifts fixed at 12/3 like the harness. Audio returns as AAC in the MP4. VANILLA attention is torch SDPA (FlashAttention on Hopper); no cache_config or quant_config, so the row is BF16 and cache-free; compile at the case shape so the first request does not recompile; JSON to /v1/videos/sync (or /v1/images/generations), whose reply is the media itself. The YAML is passed with --visual_gen_args (trtllm-serve has no --extra_visual_gen_options). VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 2xH200/4xH200). Blackwell: VANILLA beat FA4 on H3 T2VA 2-GPU, 74.33 against 76.63 s (4xB300 A/B, 2026-10-22), so it is selected there too.

framework_metadata.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
framework_metadata.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
